meta.title: StudyCard - Flashcard Learning
meta.description: A flashcard app that helps you memorize efficiently with spaced repetition. Supports iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch.

studycard.tagline: A flashcard app with spaced repetition for efficient memorization

hero.line1: 10 minutes a day, consistent repetition builds mastery.
hero.line2: A flashcard app powered by scientific spaced repetition
hero.download: Download on the App Store (Coming Soon)

preview.title: Simple yet Powerful
preview.description: Start right away without complex setup. Create cards, study, and track your growth.

features.title: Key Features
features.subtitle: The most natural flashcard experience on Apple devices

cardTypes.title: 3 Card Types
cardTypes.description: Supports text, fill-in-the-blank, and canvas cards for diverse learning styles.

spacedRepetition.title: Spaced Repetition
spacedRepetition.description: SM-2 algorithm-based level system provides scientifically optimized review intervals.

stats.title: Study Statistics
stats.description: A dashboard to track your study streaks, accuracy, and trend analysis at a glance.

pencil.title: Apple Pencil Support
pencil.description: Create handwritten and drawn cards with Apple Pencil on iPad.

widgets.title: Widgets & Reminders
widgets.description: Check your study progress from home and lock screen widgets, and stay consistent with reminders.

icloud.title: iCloud Sync
icloud.description: Automatically syncs across all Apple devices. No separate account needed — just iCloud.

platforms.title: Study Anywhere
platforms.subtitle: iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch. Natural on every Apple device.
platforms.iPad: Create canvas cards with Apple Pencil
platforms.Mac: Manage cards on a larger screen

differences.title: Why StudyCard?
differences.noTrackingDetail: All data stays on your device and iCloud only
differences.nativeDetail: Pure SwiftUI app with zero third-party dependencies

cta.title: Get Started
cta.description: Your first card will change the way you learn.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.description: This app only stores learning card data that you directly input.

storage.title: Data Storage
storage.item1: All data is stored only on your device and iCloud.
storage.item2: No data is transmitted to external servers.

sharing.title: Third-Party Sharing
sharing.description: We do not share any collected information with third parties.

tracking.title: User Tracking
tracking.description: This app does not track users. No advertising networks or analytics services are used.

deletion.title: Data Deletion
deletion.description: You can delete all data through Settings > Delete All Data.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: For inquiries about the app, please contact us through the <link>GitHub repository</link>.

footer.tagline: Dreaming to be a Developer and Entrepreneur.
